reponse: Since #447, FEATURE_FLAGS in .env.local is ignored — the frontend now reads flags from the API endpoint GET /api/flags, and the flag was renamed from new_dash to dashboards_v2 [2][3]. So locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [2][3]. Note that the earlier advice to set FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash is outdated [1], which explains why that didn't work [3]. There's also a kill switch in the admin if you need to turn it off without a deploy [4]. If your workspace is new and has no events yet, the grid may look blank by design — an empty state is being tracked separately [5].
